procedure: 1. Wait for the complete 480/480 response set (missing requests may be regenerated one-shot; existing response files are never overwritten).

2. Primary outcome: raw end-to-end native evaluation exactly as already prepared (fail-closed evaluator, hidden oracle, existing frozen predicates), recomputed from the COMPLETE response set into a fresh aggregate directory; the 02:35 partial artifacts are preserved alongside as superseded.
3. Sensitivity pass: run scripts/audit_orion_diff_interface.py over all response artifacts (arm-blind, gold-blind) writing canonicalized unified diffs to a canonical-dir outside solver view.
4. Re-run the SAME frozen native evaluation predicates on the canonicalized artifacts to obtain the syntax-normalized success rate per arm and repetition.
5. Report raw (primary) and syntax-normalized (secondary sensitivity) side by side, per arm, with per-task pairing; no other normalization is permitted.

interpretation_rules: Raw end-to-end success remains the sole primary empirical outcome of E30.
Syntax-normalized results are mechanism-attribution evidence only (interface-validity coordinate).

Under issue #47: if F2 still does not beat SIMPLE/F0 after representation validity is separated, the pressure moves to component contraction/parent replacement rather than artifact-format repair; if raw and normalized diverge materially, the interface confound is reported as a separate mechanism coordinate, not a rescue of F2.
No arm may be credited, repaired, or re-run on the basis of this sensitivity pass.
prohibitions_after_outcomes: No change to the canonicalizer, evaluator, predicates, arms, tasks, or aggregation after any E30 outcome is inspected.
Any infrastructure defect discovered after outcome access requires a new prospective run identity; the frozen endpoints are never mutated in place.
